auth.setupSubtitle: Create the administrator account for this server.
auth.setupTokenNotInTheLink: The setup token is not part of this link, so the field below is empty on purpose. Paste the token the installer printed on its own line, and use a link without it next time — a secret in a web address is written to this server's own logs and to your browser's history.
auth.passwordStrengthWeak: Too short — use at least 12 characters.
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to manage this server.
auth.twoFactorSubtitle: Enter the code that finishes signing you in.
auth.panelSubStatement: Sites, databases, backups and the people who reach them — managed from one place.

highlights.sites: Sites, databases and backups on the server you already own.
highlights.audit: Every sign-in and every change is written to an append-only journal.
highlights.twoFactor: Two-step verification, revocable sessions, and passwords hashed with Argon2id.
